title: Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Conversational AI Chatbots

bias_targets.methodology: Proposes evaluating bias through a 'Fairness Parity Score' using Wasserstein distance to compare decision distributions between demographic groups (e.g., men vs. women), and a 'Bias Detection Rate' calculating the percentage of bias-free decisions.
